title: Hyperbolic — Open-Access GPU & AI Cloud
description: Hyperbolic is the Open-Access AI Cloud. Get on-demand H100, H200 & B200 GPUs and reserve dedicated multi-node clusters for production-scale AI training and fine-tuning.
text:
Hyperbolic gives 250,000+ builders affordable on-demand GPUs to train fast, serve via an OpenAI-compatible API, and scale to production.

Trusted by leading AI teams

Hyperbolic makes building and running AI hyper simple

Launch H100, H200, B200, and other high-performance GPUs in minutes with no commitment. Best for flexible, usage-based access when you need capacity now.

Reserve dedicated capacity at discounted rates with commitments under one year. Best for steady production workloads that need predictable GPU access.

Get access to Hyperbolic's supplier network for dedicated, long-term infrastructure at the lowest cost. Best for teams that need predictable capacity and are ready for the longest-term commitment.

Deploy Affordable GPU Clusters, On Demand

Provision H100, H200, and B200 capacity in minutes without quota games, long procurement cycles, or unnecessary sales calls. Hyperbolic gives teams fast access to GPU clusters through a global network of compute providers. Use On-Demand when you need flexible capacity for experimentation, training, fine-tuning, inference, or short-term production workloads.

Buckle up! 💨 We're deploying your GPUs...

Self-serve GPU compute, built for flexibility

Launch and manage on-demand GPU instances in minutes from a clean, intuitive dashboard. No sales calls, no forms, and no long wait times. Scale usage up or down as needed and only pay for the compute you use.

We provide affordable GPU access for those at the edges of AI
